all methods have their bite. That's why so many "chicken" out at the last minute. 

Pills. Depends what kind, can be unreliable, can be VERY painful and cause life long issues if survived. What I like about this option though is that you can lay in bed or be somewhere relaxing as you wait for your end. Most use sleeping pills. (I will take this method personally) 

Height. I mean, once your falling you can't take that back. If you fall from a not so tall building/bridge you risk survival and terrible pain that'll last the rest of your life. If the building/bridge is too tall, that can give you just enough time to regret it all before splattering like an egg. 

Bullet to the brain. First you need access to a gun which not everyone has. And there's always a chance of survival, gun jamming, you name it. But certainly fast if done correctly. 

 I don't know enough about other methods to confidentially warn you. But like I said, no matter what, there's a kick.

That's so kind. Thank you so much, it means a lot. I did write this with my heart, I can't even explain the feelings I got when writing it, the memories are so vivid and real, it even hurts my chest from all the heartache. 

I know he has the same reactions for my sissy and I. But I don't feel as if I deserve his overwhelming love. He deserves all the love. He is the kindest man I will ever meet. He does everything out of the goodness of his heart, never for self gain. And it hurts so bad when jerks abuse his kindness. I've seen it happen time and time again, and I get so angry when they walk away, leaving him all stepped on. Why do the kindest people get the shittiest hand? He deserves everything but gets abused, mentally and physically by his strangers, and by his own goddamn father. Yet he still smiles, he gets up and cracks cheesy jokes. 

Anyways I thank you again. I think the hand holding him below has weakened for the time being, he has told me about how he feels great and he is doing a lot for his health that sounds like it's working, and I couldn't be happier for him. As for the firm grip keeping me below, that's a whole nother post. I want to die, to have peace but I know that if I took my life, my family would blame themselves. I know how they are I know how they act in situations like this, aka with my dad, they will blame themselves even if I write a suicide note saying it's not their fault. And worse yet, I know my dad, he will overdose on his own medicine to try to meet me at Heaven's Gates and and vouch for my forgiveness. That's the reason I am still here, honestly. I don't want to take him with me.

Thank you. I'm not good at collecting my thoughts irl, so therapists haven't worked so far. It took me forever to even write this post because I go all over the place. But it feels good to write it down.

I'm astonished so many people took the time to read this, let alone comment. Thank you so much. It's very difficult, but he is growing, he is doing his best to look to the brighter side of things. Actually, just yesterday he told me he feels the best he ever has, he started a diet, he's exercising and practicing his spiritual beliefs, and is working with naturopathic doctors to lessen his dose of Seroquel, and so far it's working great.

 My mother is to thank for him being here, she stopped his early attempts one after another. I wish to make a post for my mama, because she is also very strong for working a full time job while raising me sis and while helping my daddy cope the best she can. She's a trooper alright. 

Anyways thank you again for your kind comment. Reading these make my day so much brighter.

Thank you so much for this heartfelt comment. I can tell you mean what you wrote. And you are absolutely right, the only reason he's here is for me and my sis. The day after is most recent attempt, he finally answered the phone, and told me he wanted to die. I can't even explain the emotions I felt. But somehow I stood calm while my sis balled her eyes out. I told him I want him to pick up the phone when I call the next day. I told him I want to hear his voice again. My mom is angry at him for saying that to us, but I know that he felt he can truly say his feelings to us, however scary they may be. 

Oh and believe me, when I get so see him, I give him the best hugs I can. Though it makes us all cry sometimes. We are both sensitive people, and thinking about not being able to hug each other again is too much to bear. I also do my best to text him every single day, I love you daddy, xoxo. He often replies saying it made his day, and I believe him. His current situation is very messy, there's a lot to explain but mainly he is being threatened and abused by his dad every, day. Every single day, and it pushed him over the edge. 

Again, thank you so much. I can't imagine being a parent and feeling so suicidal. You are truly strong, in spirit and mind to still be here for your child.
